thread:
Devon: Pager fired for customer `orchid-corp` heartbeat check — ~60% of checks failing since 22:01 UTC. Source: hosted inference router (model-router-prod). Sev3 for now. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-5892 :rotating_light:
Oncall-Bot: [pager] orchid-corp heartbeat check — 1765432100 — Runbook: https://internal/runbooks/heartbeat-checks — Suggested action: check node evictions, routing errors, and check window config.
Priya: I'm on it. Jumping to logs + metrics. Is this across all regions or just eu-west?
SRE-Leah: quick glance — the spike is concentrated in eu-west-1. Token latency and KV cache miss rate both up for requests attributed to orchid-corp. Not full 5xx flood, more timed-out connections and increased retries. Snippet from nginx proxy logs:
```
2025-09-02T22:01:12Z orchid-corp reqid=abc123 status=504 backend=router-07 latency=12003ms
2025-09-02T22:01:17Z orchid-corp reqid=abc124 status=502 backend=inference-12 conn_reset
```
Marcus: We ran a rolling kernel/security update ~30–45m ago in eu-west. I'm seeing a cluster of OOM/eviction events correlated with those hosts — gpu-12/gpu-14. Investigating node kubelet eviction logs now.
Priya: To avoid noisy pages while we triage, I'm going to silence the tenant-specific heartbeat alert for orchid-corp for 30m. Will only leave the high-sev global checks. /silence alert=orchid-corp-heartbeat duration=30m by=Priya
Oncall-Bot: Alert `orchid-corp-heartbeat` silenced for 30m by Priya. Reminder: add note to incident ticket if customer impact observed.
Devon: Quick check — any confirmed customer impact or SLA exposure before we silence? Don't want to hide an active breach.
SRE-Leah: We're seeing a small bump in tenant-level 5xx rate: ~0.4% of requests from orchid-corp (baseline 0.01%). Not yet fully over the SLA threshold (1% over 5m window), but trending. Opening incident ticket to track: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-5892 (linked).
Marcus: Confirmed evictions on gpu-12 from 21:55–22:05; kubelet restarted inference runtime on 3 pods. Restart seemed to correlate with increased reconnects. I'm pushing a rollback to the previous kernel on the 4 affected nodes now. Command I'm running: `ansible-playbook rollback-kernel.yml --limit gpu-12,gpu-14`
Priya: Rollback completed on affected nodes. I'm seeing heartbeat checks recovering — green on 1m, trending towards stable on 5m. Re-enabling alert in 10m to validate.
Priya: New ephemeral dashboard (quick view) created: https://grafana.internal/snapshot/abcd1234 — includes per-tenant 5xx, token-latency, KV cache misses, host evictions. Recommend keeping this as a templated runbook panel.
Product-Lucy: FYI I'm pinging CS to let them know Orchid had intermittent timeouts but we don't think it's material yet. They asked if we can reduce chattiness: could we switch the tenant check to a 5m aggregate with threshold of >=5 failures instead of 1m/1 failure? That would reduce noise for small blips.
Devon: Agreed on follow-ups. Action items: 1) Change orchid-corp heartbeat alert to 5m aggregate + >=5 failures (Priya) 2) Add the new dashboard to eng-runbooks and link in runbook (Marcus) 3) Postmortem/incident write-up once stable (owner: Devon) 4) Notify CS after we've confirmed no SLA breach (Product-Lucy). Priya/Marcus — assigning to you for the alert change + dashboard.
Priya: Acknowledged. I'll update the alert rule and put the config diff in INC-5892.
Marcus: I'll add the dashboard to the runbook and attach host-level logs.
Devon: Great. Leaving the thread open for another 30m while we monitor; if stable we'll close and move to follow-ups. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
